subtitle: HP grounding makes the critical heal explicit
synopsis: S3 adds game-specific grounding to the reasoning format. The prompt tells the agent to check whether one more 20-damage attack would leave it alive. In this replay, FlashLite-S3-HP repeatedly reasons through HP and resources, then reaches the decisive HP=20 moment and explicitly heals because 20 minus 20 would not survive. This is the strategy stack becoming an operational procedure.
